description.narrative: Insatsen ska stödja somaliska civilsamhällesorganisationer genom en gemensam givarmekanism (Facility) som upphandlats av Danmarks ambassad. Syftet med stödet är att utöka det utrymmet för kvinnor, ungdomar och marginaliserade grupper i Somalia och Somaliland och stärka medborgarnas engagemang för mänskliga rättigheter och ansvarsutkrävande gentemot staten på federal nivå, medlemsstatsnivå och lokal nivå.

This contribution will support Somali civil society organisation, through a joint donor mechanism (Facility) procured by the Embassy of Denmark. Thee aim of the support is to expand the civic space for women, youth and marginalised groups in Somalia and Somaliland and strengthen citizen engagement on rights and accountability with the state at federal level, member state level and local level.

Vision CEF works to expand Somali civic space and catalyze collective action.
Impact Expanded civic space
The programme has the following main expected outcomes and outputs:
Outcome 1 Improved channels for civic actors to participate in or convene political dialogue and inform policy, where relevant
Output 1.1 Research institutions publish research with relevance to civic issues, as well as policy questions
Output 1.2 Facilitation of conferences/meetings for discussion of civic and policy issues based on evidence between research institutions, civic actors, and decision makers
Output 1.3 Research institutions build coalitions to undertake initiatives on dialogue and research
Outcome 2 Improved accountability through innovative and more inclusive practices
Output 2.1 New and innovative ways of amplifying civic voices or improving collective action
Outcome 3 Civic actors influence decision-making and collective problem-solving processes
Output 3.1 Civic actors and community members and associations engage on shared priorities
Output 3.2 Meetings and discussions between local civic actors and decision makers around shared priorities
Outcome 4 Improved collaboration between civic actors at all levels
Output 4.1 Joint advocacy and/or collective action by civic actors
Output 4.2 Civic actors convene around shared learning, knowledge exchange, and collaboration
